parameters.query:
select distinct on (c.id)
  c.id as conversacion_id, c.telefono, c.agente_id, c.contacto_id, c.canal_numero,
  ca.botmaker_token, ca.channel_id_botmaker, f.id as follow_up_id, f.orden, f.mensaje,
  f.tipo, f.intent_hsm, f.variables_hsm, c.variables_recolectadas,
  case when coalesce(c.variables_recolectadas->>'nombre','') <> ''
    then replace(f.mensaje, '{{' || 'nombre' || '}}', split_part(c.variables_recolectadas->>'nombre', ' ', 1))
    else replace(replace(f.mensaje, ' ' || '{{' || 'nombre' || '}}', ''), '{{' || 'nombre' || '}}', '') end as mensaje_final
from conversaciones c
join follow_ups f on f.agente_id = c.agente_id and f.activo
join canales ca on ca.canal_numero = c.canal_numero and ca.activo
where c.transbordado = false and c.pausado = false
  and c.contacto_id is not null and ca.botmaker_token is not null
  and c.ultimo_mensaje_lead is not null
  and (
    (f.tipo = 'texto' and now() - c.ultimo_mensaje_lead < interval '24 hours')
    or (f.tipo = 'hsm' and c.contacto_id is not null and now() - c.ultimo_mensaje_lead < interval '30 days')
  )
  and now() - c.ultimo_mensaje_lead >= make_interval(mins => f.delay_minutos)
  and not exists (select 1 from follow_up_envios e where e.conversacion_id = c.id and e.follow_up_id = f.id)
order by c.id, f.orden;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ chat: { channelId: $json.channel_id_botmaker, contactId: $json.contacto_id }, intentIdOrName: $json.intent_hsm, variables: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify($json.variables_hsm || {}).split('{{nombre}}').join((($json.variables_recolectadas||{}).nombre)||'')) }) }}
